title: Auxiliary Field Deformations of the Lambda Model
summary: Many examples of integrable sigma models admit families of integrable deformations that involve coupling the undeformed ``seed'' theory to auxiliary fields with algebraic equations of motion. In this work, we apply this paradigm to the case where the seed theory is the lambda model, which interpolates between the Wess-Zumino-Witten model and the non-Abelian T-dual of the principal chiral model.
